jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Partner Manager Logistik (all genders) bist Du ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Logistik Operations Teams und verantwortest die ganzheitliche Performance sowie die strategischen Beziehungen zu unseren externen Last Mile und Middle Mile Partnern. Im Rahmen regelmäßiger Business Reviews analysierst Du relevante Kennzahlen und treibst bei Abweichungen konkrete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen voran. Gleichzeitig leitest Du Projekte, um Kosten, Qualität sowie CO₂-Emissionen zu optimieren und unserer Kundschaft nachhaltig ein zuverlässiges Liefererlebnis zu bieten.

Bitte beachte, dass diese Stelle auf 24 Monate befristet ist (eine anschließende Entfristung wird angestrebt).

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Steuerung des Carrier-Managements für unsere Last Mile und Middle Mile Partner einschließlich der Durchführung regelmäßiger Business Reviews, kontinuierlichen Leistungsoptimierung, Umsetzung von Maßnahmenplänen sowie Einhaltung definierter SLAs
  • Analyse transportbezogener Kennzahlen und Dienstleister-Performances zur Aufdeckung von Abweichungen und Ableitung  wirksamer Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Prüfung der Abrechnungsprozesse aller externen Logistikpartner und Abgleich von Kosten sowie Budgets zur Identifikation von Einsparpotenzialen in der gesamten DACH-Region
  • Durchführung von Verhandlungen zu Preismodellen, Servicevereinbarungen und Arbeitsweisen mit dem Ziel maximaler Kosteneffizienz bei gleichbleibend hoher Qualität
  • Überwachung und Reporting zentraler Nachhaltigkeits-KPIs und Vorantreiben der Reduzierung von CO₂-Emissionen in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Partnernetzwerken

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Steuerung und Betreuung externer Kurier-, Express- und Paketdienstleister sowie Spediteure, kombiniert mit herausragendem Verhandlungsgeschick

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenz sowie souveränes Auftreten in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen internen Stakeholdern und externen Partnern
  • Lösungsorientierte, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und pragmatischer Umgang mit dynamischen operativen Herausforderungen
  • Fließende Deutsch- (mind.  C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Niveau)

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer - Applied AI & LLMs (x/f/m)
jobs.description: What you’ll do We are looking for a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to join the DS & AI organization at Doctolib. This is a transversal force multiplier role operating across all AI teams: Clinical, Productivity, Phone Assistant and ASR. Rather than working within a single feature team, you will own the cross-cutting technical challenges: defining how Doctolib's product and AI teams build agentic solutions, standardizing ML evaluation frameworks, and spreading strong engineering practices across the org. You will unblock teams, shape architecture decisions, and take on the deep technical work that requires senior ML judgment at scale, directly impacting the daily lives of 400,000 healthcare professionals and the health of 80 million patients. Building at Doctolib means delivering innovative products that measurably improve outcomes for care teams and patients alike. Technical Strategy & Architecture Own cross-team ML architecture decisions, from model selection to production deployment patterns and strategic build vs. buy decisions Define and drive adoption of rigorous evaluation frameworks across all AI teams, setting the standard for how Doctolib measures model and agentic performance Establish shared production infrastructure patterns for AI: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimization, and observability Lead the technical design of agentic solutions and define how product teams across Doctolib build on top of AI capabilities Elevate technical standards across the DS & AI org by influencing Staff and Senior ML Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, and practice propagation Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure safe rollout and meet EU regulatory expectations (GDPR, MDR, EU AI Act) Who you are Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You'll be a great fit if: You have 10+ years in ML/AI with 3+ years at Staff+ or Principal level leading complex, multi-team technical initiatives You have deep expertise in at least two of: clinical NLP, LLM fine-tuning and evaluation, automatic speech recognition, RAG systems, or reinforcement learning You are expert in Python, PyTorch/Transformers for training, and vLLM for inference with a track record deploying ML systems in production (AWS/GCP) You have a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent research experience) You have exceptional communication skills and are able to align diverse stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions Now it would be fantastic if you have: Publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL) or medical informatics venues Experience with EU healthcare regulations (GDPR, MDR, AI Act) Prior work with clinical data or healthcare applications Life at Doctolib Tech Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform supporting web and mobile interfaces across multiple languages and healthcare specialties. Our stack includes Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native. We leverage AI ethically to empower patients and professionals. Discover our AI vision here . Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . What we offer A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days) Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period) The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support Relocation support in case of international mobility Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training The interview process HR Screen Hiring Manager Interview Technical Interview Technical Case Study Behavioral Interview At least one reference check We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more on our candidate experience page . Job details Permanent position Full-time Berlin Hybrid work mode (up to 2 remote days per week) Start date: as soon as possible We welcome everyone At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from or what you look like. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. We respect and celebrate diversity! The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply

jobs.description: 15.10.2026, Berliner Wasserbetriebe Berlin Leiter:in Team Betrieb von Wasserzähleranlagen (w/m/d) Über uns: In der Wasserversorgung stellen wir die Aufbereitung und Verteilung des Trinkwassers in Berlin sicher und sind verantwortlich für Bau, Betrieb sowie Instandhaltung von Rohren, Pump- und Wasserwerken. Die Berliner Wasserbetriebe sind mit knapp 4.900 Beschäftigten eines der größten Unternehmen der Wasser- und Abwasserbranche in Deutschland. Als Unternehmen des Landes Berlin möchten wir zur Gestaltung der lebendigen und modernen Metropole Berlin beitragen. Die Berliner Wasserbetriebe gelten weit über die Stadtgrenzen hinaus als stabiles Wirtschaftsunternehmen und verlässlicher Arbeitgeber. Aufgaben: Leiten und strategisches Weiterentwickeln des Teams Betrieb von WZ-Anlagen unter den Rahmenbedingungen der kontinuierlichen Modernisierung und Digitalisierung des Zählerparks Fachliches und disziplinarisches Führen von aktuell 31 Mitarbeitenden Steuern und Optimieren der Prozesse des Baus und Betriebs von Wasserzähleranlagen sowie Mitarbeit bei deren weiterer Digitalisierung Implementieren aktueller technischer und gesetzlicher Entwicklungen in die Arbeitsprozesse Lösen von Herausforderungen zum Erreichen fristgerechter Arbeitsergebnisse durch Moderation und Vermittlung innerhalb und außerhalb des Unternehmens Mitwirken in Fachaustauschen von Experten zu aktuellen Themen Qualifikationen: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Versorgungstechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit einschlägigen Kenntnissen in stellenrelevanten Aufgaben Alternativ: Bachelor Versorgungstechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung sowie ergänzenden Kenntnissen, die es erlauben zu einem Wissensstand, wie er in einem Masterstudium vermittelt wird, aufzuschließen Erfahrung bei der Führung von Mitarbeitenden (Führungs- und Sozialkompetenz) Vertiefte Kenntnisse der DIN-Vorschriften zur Sicherung der Trinkwasserinstallation sowie des Betriebs von Wasserzähleranlagen Fundierte Kenntnisse der gültigen Regeln für die Trinkwasserinstallation Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der vertraglichen Grundlagen der Wasserversorgung (AVB WasserV/Satzung und Eichrecht) Strategische und Methodenkompetenz Wir bieten: Kontinuierlich weiterentwickelte Technologien für den Berliner Wasserkreislauf Aktive Forschung zum Ausbau des Umweltschutzes Sinnvolle Aufgaben mit Verantwortung und Teamgeist Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven und -förderung (z. B. Female Leadership Programm, individuelle Personalentwicklungspläne, interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten) Work-Life-Balance: 39-Stunden-Woche, 30 Tage Urlaub/Jahr, bei entsprechender Tätigkeit kann 60 % der Arbeitszeit je Quartal im mobilen Arbeiten erfolgen, diverse Arbeitszeitmodelle (neben Vollzeit oder Teilzeit z. B. Sabbatical, Gleitzeit, 10 zusätzliche Urlaubstage durch Entgeltumwandlung etc.), betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL), vermögenswirksame Leistungen (VWL), Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Job, Corporate Benefits Mitarbeiterangebote, 39 Wochen Entgeltfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall, betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement (u. a. Fahrradleasing), professionelle Mitarbeiter:innenberatung zu allen Lebenslagen Bezahlung Wir bieten Ihnen eine Vergütung in der Entgeltgruppe 12 nach dem Tarifvertrag Versorgungsbetriebe (TV-V) an. Je nach Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen kann eine Eingruppierung auch in eine niedrigere Entgeltgruppe erfolgen. Unser Kontakt: Haben Sie Fragen rund um die Anstellung bei den Berliner Wasserbetrieben oder den Bewerbungsprozess? Ihre Recruiterin Seda Demirel beantwortet gern Ihre Fragen. E-Mail: bewerbung@bwb.de Berliner Wasserbetriebe | Recruiting | 10864 Berlin Weitere Informationen: Menschen mit Behinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt. Da wir uns Chancengleichheit und die berufliche Förderung von Frauen zum Ziel gesetzt haben, sind wir besonders an Bewerbungen von Frauen interessiert. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. The role

The team spans Paid Social, Paid Search, Display & Video, Partnerships & Affiliates, Creative Strategy and the Creators program, and steers one of the largest acquisition budgets in direct-to-consumer. We are rebuilding the organization around fewer, stronger channel leaders and an AI-first way of working, and this role is central to making that model run.

We are looking for an Associate Director of Paid Strategy to own the strategy, planning and operating backbone of Global Paid Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Global Paid Marketing, you will set how the paid portfolio plans its budget, runs its business reviews and prioritizes and delivers its biggest bets.

Channel leaders own their numbers. You own the system around them: the plan they commit to, the cadence that holds them to it, the cross-channel programs no single team owns, and the insightsthat turns many channels and dozens of entities into one clear view of the business. It is a role with unusual breadth and visibility, built for someone who wants to understand how a large paid organization is run, not just how one channel performs.

You will work directly with the paid leadership team, with StratOps as your closest partner: StratOps sets the company-wide growth agenda and governance, and you translate it into how paid team plans, operates and reports, then bring the paid view back into that agenda. You will also partner closely with Finance, Analytics, HR and Brand. This role is primarily designed as an Individual Contributor position: ; your impact  comes from the quality of your thinking, the rigor of your follow-through and the trust you earn.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

Paid strategy and planning

  • Own the planning cycle for the global paid portfolio: annual Business Plan, half-year budgets and monthly MBT re-forecasts, from channel-mix and entity allocation through to CAC and volume guardrails.
  • Partner with StratOps and Finance so paid commitments tie to company targets, and pressure-test every submission based on run-rates and data-driven assumptions  
  • Shape the multi-year paid strategy: where to invest, where to pull back, and which capabilities the organization needs to build.

Operating rhythm and governance

  • Design and run the operating cadence of the paid organization: weekly and monthly business reviews, QBRs, leadership team meetings and senior leadership steerings.
  • Set agendas, write or commission pre-reads, and own the decision and action log so every meeting ends with an owner and a date, and every commitment is followed through.
  • Define the KPIs, targets and reporting standards that let leadership compare channels and entities on one consistent basis.

Cross-channel programs

  • Lead the high-priority initiatives that span channels and no single team owns, such as measurement and incrementality, partner and agency consolidation, and AI adoption across the team.
  • Run them with clear scope, milestones and owners, and escalate early when they drift.
  • Conduct and synthesize ad hoc strategic analysis to support paid leadership with decision marking or problem solving

Insight and executive communication

  • Turn performance across channels and entities into a single, narrative for senior leadership: CMO updates, QBRs, steering decks and budget reviews.
  • Ensure high quality and consistent deliverable from the Paid team to Leadership to enable fast and informed decision making  

Organization and capability planning

  • Support org design, headcount and people-cost planning for Global Paid Marketing, working with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition.
  • Track priority hiring and internal moves, and keep one source of truth for the team's structure and capacity.
  • Drive knowledge transfer and best-practice sharing across channels and markets.

AI-enabled operations

The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.
  • Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.
  • Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.
  • Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

  • Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.
  • Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.
  • Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.
  • Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

  • Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.
  • Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.
  • Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.
  • Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

  • Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.
  • Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.
  • Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.
  • Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education

  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.
  • Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.
  • Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.
  • Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct adva

Deine Rolle

Als Transport Operations Manager (all genders) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion und Auslieferung. Du verantwortest die reibungslose und datenbasierte Steuerung unserer Middle-Mile-Transporte zwischen unseren beiden Produktionsstandorten, dem internen Last-Mile-Netzwerk und externen Partnern in der DACH-Region. Dabei behältst Du auch bei kurzfristigen Herausforderungen den Überblick und findest schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, um unsere Supply Chain zuverlässig am Laufen zu halten.

Zudem optimierst Du laufend unsere operativen Prozesse und steigerst damit nachhaltig die Effizienz sowie Zuverlässigkeit unserer Transporte. 

Bitte beachte, dass diese Stelle auf 24 Monate befristet ist (eine anschließende Entfristung wird angestrebt).

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Strategische Planung und Überwachung aller Middle-Mile-Transporte mit dem Ziel, einen reibungslosen Warenfluss von den Produktionsstandorten direkt zu den Logistik Hubs sicherzustellen
  • Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender IT-Lösungen für die Transportplanung sowie aktive Einbringung von Fachwissen zur weiteren Automatisierung und Optimierung von Systemen und Prozessen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit externen Transportdienstleistern und internen Fachbereichen als zentrale Schnittstelle zur Abstimmung aller Beteiligten und zur schnellen Klärung und Lösung operativer Abweichungen
  • Proaktive Bewältigung unerwarteter Engpässe und kritischer logistischer Herausforderungen durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung pragmatischer Ad-hoc-Lösungen
  • Erstellung detaillierter, datenbasierter Performance-Auswertungen und Transportpläne zur Bewertung, Steuerung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Leistung von Transportpartnern
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Planungsprozesse durch eigenständige Identifikation von Ineffizienzen sowie Entwicklung und Umsetzung intelligenter und skalierbarer Verbesserungen

Dein Profil 

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Transportmanagement, idealerweise in einem dynamischen Umfeld oder in der Frischelogistik
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit großen KEP-Dienstleistern (Kurier-, Express- und Paketdienste) sowie führenden Speditionspartnern 
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Transport Management Systemen (TMS) sowie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in MS Office / Google Workspace, insbesondere Excel, Power Query und Pivot-Tabellen, zur datenbasierten Analyse und Entscheidungsfindung
  • Lösungsorientierte, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Entscheidungsstärke und Souveränität, auch in stressigen Situationen
  • Ruhige und proaktive Arbeitsweise auch in dynamischen bzw. zeitkritischen Situationen, ausgeprägte Entscheidungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an  kontinuierlicher Prozessoptimierung
  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Samstagen und Feiertagen
  • Fließende Deutsch- (mind.  C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Niveau)

Vor allem suchen wir Menschen, die HelloFresh besser machen. Wir lieben vielfältige Erfahrungen und glauben, dass es viele Wege gibt, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln. Wenn Du also nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, aber glaubst, in dieser Rolle überzeugen zu können, möchten wir gerne mehr über Dich erfahren.

Das bieten wir Dir

  • Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz mit einem tollen Team in Berlin-Kreuzberg
  • Rabatte auf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen und Convini-Produkte
  • Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Trainings sowie ein jährliches Team-Budget für Weiterbildung

  • Unterstützungsangebote bei der Kinderbetreuung

jobs.description:
Lead Copywriter, Global Creative Studio (m/f/x)

Brand Marketing · Berlin or Warsaw

At HelloFresh Group, our mission is to change the way people eat forever. Since our 2011 founding in Berlin, we've become the global market leader in the meal kit sector, inspiring millions of home cooks and food lovers every week. Our portfolio spans eight brands across 16 markets, from HelloFresh and Factor to Good Chop and Pets Table.

ABOUT THE JOB

If you love making words work hard, this might be your job.

HelloFresh Group is looking for a Lead Copywriter to join our Creative Studio and help drive copy quality across our demand generation engine. You'll work across the full funnel and across every channel that matters (TV, OOH, paid social, display, CRM, YouTube) with a particular focus on mid-funnel, paid social creative that stops thumbs and starts conversations.

This is a hands-on writing role, creating everything from campaign headlines to push notifications, from social hooks to CRM journeys. You'll also bring the strategic thinking to help shape how eight global brands communicate across sixteen markets, and the collaborative instinct to consult with local teams, advise channel owners, and help more junior staffers write better.

Crucially, you will help build, train, and socialize AI tools (particularly on Claude and Gemini) to create and maintain  a broad creative toolkit. You will use these tools to generate, iterate, and localize content, but you will be the creative brain behind all LLM work.

This position is based in Berlin or Warsaw. Berlin-based employees have required attendance three days per week (Monday to Wednesday) at our Creative Studio in Moabit.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Write sharp, on-brand copy across the full funnel and all major channels (paid social, display, CRM, YouTube, TV, and OOH), with a particular emphasis on mid-funnel paid social creative.
  • Bring big-picture strategic thinking to campaign briefs and creative concepts, while staying just as comfortable writing a single subject line or a two-second video hook.
  • Consult with local market copywriting teams across sixteen markets, offering guidance, feedback, and creative direction that keeps their work on-brand and high-quality.
  • Use AI tools (especially Claude and Gemini) as part of your creative workflow: for ideation, iteration, and developing prompt frameworks and localization pipelines that improve quality and efficiency at scale.
  • Advise channel owners and marketing stakeholders on copy strategy, messaging hierarchy, and how to make creative work harder at every touchpoint.
  • Help shape, evolve, and maintain tone of voice and messaging guidelines across eight brands, ensuring they’re clear and practical enough to use at local and global levels.
  • Partner with designers, videographers, motion designers, and performance marketers to bring creative ideas to life and optimize them for conversion.
  • Interpret performance data to understand what's working, and use those insights to improve briefs, iterate on copy, and sharpen your craft.
  • Rigorously proofread copy. Zero typos, zero grammatical errors, no exceptions.
  • Manage content flows via Google Suite, Airtable, and Jira so copy moves efficiently from brief to stakeholders to market.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • A full-time copywriter based in, or willing to relocate to, Berlin or Warsaw.
  • BS/MS from a top-tier university in Communications, Marketing, Creative Writing, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of copywriting or communications experience, ideally spanning both agency and in-house environments.
  • A proven track record of high-impact, English-language copy across major digital channels, especially paid social, display, CRM, email, and YouTube.
  • A strategic thinker who can see the big picture across brands and markets, but who is equally happy polishing a push notification or reworking a subject line.
  • An experienced AI worker, using LLMs as part of a creative process to generate, refine, and localize copy more effectively.
  • A natural collaborator who can consult with and advise local teams and channel owners—someone who leads through the quality of their thinking.
  • Comfortable working within brand and tone guidelines, and experienced enough to know when to push the boundaries.
  • Ability to write across multiple projects, brands, markets, and tones simultaneously.
  • A curiosity about audiences and the ability to interpret performance data to refine copy strategy.
  • Experience with localization and machine translation workflows is a plus.
  • Agency experience, particularly at a social media-focused or digital agency, is a plus.
  • Experience working for food or tech brands is a plus.
  • Knowledge of German, French, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Dutch is a plus.

ARE YOU UP FOR THE CHALLENGE?

To apply, please complete the application and send us a portfolio that shows your range: performance-driven digital copy, campaign thinking across brands or markets, and any examples of how you've worked smarter—whether that's AI-assisted workflows, localization processes, or something else entirely.

We're excited to see what you bring to the team.

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a highly driven Steering & Planning Associate for our Customer Risk Lifecycle (CRL) domain, helping achieve N26’s ambition to be a pioneer in the prevention of Financial Crime.

This presents a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge initiatives in an ever-changing space to safeguard N26 customers from fraud, scams, and digital identity attacks, and safeguard the bank against money launderers and money mules through their whole risk lifecycle.

You will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between strategy and execution, helping N26 grow and run better by translating ambitious goals into clear KPIs and tangible results. In this role, you will be part of a high-impact team that acts as a strategic partner to leadership, driving value and business resilience across our core risk and compliance lines.

If you are interested in learning how we leverage technologies like Machine Learning and Generative AI end-to-end—from a front-end UX perspective to back-end and staff tooling at onboarding, device pairing, payment, and card transactions—this position is for you! You will be working on initiatives that are at the heart of all risk-based decisions that support new and existing product propositions while ensuring compliance with future regulations.

In this role, you will:

  • Help ensure the Anti Financial Crime Strategy is well-defined, owning and refining the segment strategy to enable data-driven trade-offs across the Customer Risk Lifecycle.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, developing a deep understanding of business drivers, infrastructure, and processes related to financial crime prevention and staff investigations.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing workflows and performance metrics to identify inefficiencies, streamline processes, implement automation, and support scalable business growth.
  • Monitor KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with company objectives, proactively reviewing data and performance insights.
  • Identify and prioritize key product and strategic initiatives to deliver against our KPIs, uncovering opportunities to optimize the user experience and risk-rate customers effectively.
  • Manage and maintain critical vendor and external service provider relationships, ensuring strong collaboration, performance tracking, and compliance with SLAs and risk management protocols.
  • Develop business cases to evaluate the cost, impact and value of new opportunities.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, ensuring strong project management, clear ownership, timely delivery, and continuous optimization.
  • Monitor performance and optimize outcomes, including product KPIs, unit economics, and external partner delivery against SLAs.
  • Act as the central connector across teams and partners, aligning stakeholders (Product, Tech, Data, Growth, Finance, etc.), resolving blockers, and driving execution on complex, high-impact topics in a dynamic environment.

What you need to be successful:

Background:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in fast-paced environments such as fintech, banking, consulting, startups, or corporate strategy roles—ideally within regulated industries or financial services
  • Bachelor's degree in STEM, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Management or a related field from a top-tier university.
  • Strong understanding of scalable process design, automation technologies, and standardization best practices.
  • An analytical mindset to deconstruct complex problems with a focus on delivering data-driven impact.

Skills & Traits:

  • Project management experience, particularly in cross-functional teams with Product, Tech, or Operations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams in a multicultural environment across various areas of expertise.
  • Comfortable working independently on compliance and regulatory-related topics and engaging with relevant stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Agile mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive, growth-oriented attitude.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills; fluency in Excel and project management tools is essential.
  • Proficient in SQL and confident in working with data to drive decisions.
  • Strong storytelling and visual communication skills using PowerPoint.
  • Passion for the banking and fintech industry, with a desire to deepen understanding of how N26 operates.
  • Experience with operational processes optimization and understanding key drivers of customer satisfaction are a plus.
  • Curious about new anti-financial crime technologies and how users and fraudsters will respond to them.
  • Fluent in English.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

jobs.title: Treasury Trader
jobs.address: Barcelona, 67, Müllerstraße, Afrikanisches Viertel, Wedding, Mitte, Berlin, 13349, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

As our new Treasury Trader you will autonomously drive core treasury operations, liquidity and cash management, and investments (with a primary focus on public sector financing). Operating with high autonomy, you will manage the short term Treasury book, central bank operations, assess bank’s liquidity position and monitor key KPIs. Acting as a crucial bridge across Group Risk, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting, you will also as 1 LoD maintain audit readiness to ensure complete operational stability.

You will also enjoy our hybrid work model - flexibility of working both from home, and from our office in Barcelona. 

In this role, you will:

  • Trade Execution & Portfolio Management: Evaluate potential investment opportunities, then price (Bloomberg experience required), execute, and log transactions across Front Office tools, focusing primarily on public sector financing and short maturities. Proactively manage money market products and the short-term book, including Repo and Reverse Repo portfolios.
  • Liquidity & Reserve Management: Oversee key liquidity functions, including Bundesbank cash pooling, Eurosystem minimum reserve requirements, overnight deposits, credit lines, and short-term portfolio hedging.
  • Payment Systems & Central Bank Operations: Serve as the primary deputy for key payment and settlement infrastructure (Target, ESMIG, MACCS) and oversee central bank account management.
  • Audit, Compliance & Governance: Support internal and external audits, enforce compliance with key banking regulations, and drive First Line of Defense (1LoD) risk management.
  • Product & Tech Initiatives: Lead New Product Process (NPP) implementations, vendor onboarding, core banking system enhancements, and automated reporting solutions using SQL.

 

What you need to be successful:

  • Experience: Strong background in bank treasury operations, liquidity management, and money markets, with a preference for hands-on Repo/Reverse Repo and hedging experience.
  • Technical & System Expertise: Solid familiarity with Treasury Front Office tools (Bloomberg experience required), payment and settlement systems (Target, ESMIG, MACCS), and data querying skills (SQL).
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of financial markets combined with a sound grasp of Eurosystem frameworks, reserve requirements, and key European banking regulations (including MaRisk, CRR III, and KWG).
  • Ownership: Proven ability to drive cross-functional projects, step in as a trusted deputy across core functions, and operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. 
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a passionate, technically-minded Product Manager - Product Factory to join our Core Systems team. Our mission is to disrupt traditional core banking technology standards by building highly configurable, modular, and automated solutions that enable rapid financial product launches across Europe, backed by automated compliance and seamless data flows.

The Core Systems segment is split between our Barcelona and Berlin, which serve as the primary product and tech hubs for N26 globally.

What is the "Product Factory"?

The Product Factory is the central engine room of N26’s core banking platform. Rather than hardcoding software from scratch for every new country or account type, the Product Factory builds the modular "building blocks" (flexible APIs, internal configuration engines, and a centralized product catalog) of the bank.

As the Product Manager for this group, you will own the internal platforms that allow N26 to dynamically mix, match, and launch new financial products (like specialized savings accounts, premium tiers, or localized lending features) in a highly competitive, scalable, and compliant manner.

In this role you will:

  • Build Internal Self-Service Tools: Drive the strategy and execution for self-service product configuration and orchestration tools, enabling internal regional and market teams to launch or modify financial products without needing engineering intervention.
  • Own Platform Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the roadmap for N26's core product infrastructure, including the orchestration of transactional and gateway data flows that power our underlying financial systems.
  • Manage the Central Product Catalog: Maintain and scale the central system of record for N26's financial features, interest rates, limits, and fee structures, ensuring high system availability and data integrity.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other product managers, designers, and core engineers to continuously improve N26's platform architecture, ensuring it aligns with global business goals.
  • Navigate Compliance & Rollouts: Work closely with cross-functional domains, including Local Market Teams, Legal, Operations, and Compliance to ensure that automated compliance guardrails are baked directly into the Product Factory framework for seamless market rollouts.
  • Vendor & Third-Party Integration: Oversee technical relationships and integrations with high-engagement third-party core banking providers and external financial vendors.

What you need to be successful:

  • Experience: 4+ years of Product Management experience, ideally gained within a FinTech, modern banking environment, core banking provider, or a highly complex platform/API-driven ecosystem.
  • Technical & Data Acumen: Strong familiarity with backend architectures, relational databases, system integrations, and building/managing internal API products. You speak the language of engineering effortlessly.
  • Domain Knowledge: Proven experience working with centralized digital product catalogs, configuration engines, or complex financial orchestration systems.
  • Vendor Management: Previous experience managing high-engagement third-party vendors and aligning external roadmaps with internal engineering goals is a major plus.
  • Education: Undergraduate degree in a STEM field, Business, or Economics. An MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
  • Execution & Communication: An autonomous, adaptive operator with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong bias for action, and exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Agile Mastery: A deep understanding of agile product development, continuous integration, and scalable delivery practices.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

jobs.description: Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst Berlin, Hamburg Berlin, Hamburg Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst Jetzt bewerben Als zentraler Dienstleister für Sparkassen stehen wir für Qualität, Innovation und Verlässlichkeit. Mit rund 1.400 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Deutschland sorgen wir täglich dafür, dass Prozesse und digitale Lösungen in der Marktfolge effizient laufen. So können sich Sparkassen auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren: ihre Kundinnen und Kunden. Wir befinden uns im Neuaufbau einer schlagkräftigen Vertriebsorganisation und als Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst gestalten Sie Strukturen von Beginn an mit. Dafür suchen wir eine unternehmerisch geprägte Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die den Markt bundesweit eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und den S-Servicepartner Deutschland als strategischen Partner der Sparkassen nachhaltig positioniert. Wir freuen uns mit Ihnen gemeinsam Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen! Ihre neuen Aufgaben Sie führen das Vertriebsaußendienst-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch und entwickeln es weiter Dabei haben Sie die Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung Sie sichern das jährlich neu zu akquirierende Geschäft – vom absehbaren Folgebedarf des Kunden aus Sie führen den gesamten Kundenprozess: von Zugang und Bedarf über Angebot und Abschluss bis zu Wiederbeauftragung und Weiterentwicklung Zudem bauen Sie Zugänge zu Vorständen und Entscheidern auf und führen auch komplexe Entscheidungen verbindlich zum Abschluss Sie steuern den End-to-End-Vertriebsprozess über Fachbereiche, Innendienst und Servicefunktionen – lateral über klare Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Entscheidungsrechte Für diesen Auftrag erhalten Sie ein klares Mandat zur Steuerung der umsatzrelevanten Kundenprozesse über die beteiligten Einheiten hinweg – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichsleitung und Fachbereichen Ihren Bereich führen Sie mit Zahlen: Pipeline, Forecast, Abschluss- und Wiederbeauftragungsquote Ihre Stärken zählen Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung mit disziplinarischer Verantwortung: Sie haben Vertriebsteams aufgebaut oder neu ausgerichtet Messbare Erfolge im B2B-Lösungsvertrieb komplexer Dienstleistungen – von Zugang und Lösung bis Abschluss und Kundenentwicklung Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse der Sparkassenfinanzgruppe Erfahrung mit Geschäft, das regelmäßig neu gewonnen oder verlängert werden muss Diplomatisches Geschick, Verhandlungsstärke und klare Abschlussorientierung Fähigkeit, einen komplexen B2B-Markt zu durchdringen, tragfähige Beziehungen aufzubauen und zum Abschluss zu führen Hohe Reisebereitschaft Unsere Benefits Gehalt: Wir zahlen fair und transparent dank unserer starken Betriebsvereinbarung. Die Vergütung dieser Position richtet sich nach Ihren Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen. Work-Life-Balance: Mit einer Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6 – 20 Uhr ohne Kernzeiten und individuellen Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten bieten wir Ihnen die Flexibilität, die Sie brauchen. Mobilität: Unkomplizierte Arbeitswege – mit unserem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, attraktivem Fahrradleasing und allseits bequemer Anbindung. Perspektive: Ein anspruchsvolles und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum – wir wachsen gemeinsam. Gesundheit: Mit unserem betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement sorgen wir aktiv für Ihr Wohlbefinden. Und das fängt bereits bei höhenverstellbaren Tischen an. Gemeinschaft: Unser Erfolg beruht auf starken Teams, die verlässlich und vertrauensvoll zusammenarbeiten. Unser kollegiales Miteinander zeigt sich im Workshop ebenso wie auf dem Betriebsfest. Unsere Benefits sind so vielfältig wie Ihre Karrierewege bei uns. HIER finden Sie alle Angebote. Lust bekommen? Dann direkt über unser kurzes Online-Formular bewerben! Doch noch offene Fragen? jobs.description: Serviceassistenz (m/w/d) | BritCars | Berlin/ Spandau bei Autohaus Dinnebier GmbH | softgarden View job here Serviceassistenz (m/w/d) | BritCars | Berlin/ Spandau Vollzeit Brunsbütteler Damm 192-194, 13581 Berlin Mit Berufserfahrung 21.09.26 Die Unternehmensgruppe Dinnebier sucht zur Festanstellung: Serviceassistentz (m/w/d) BritCars in Berlin / Spandau Unsere Mission: Wir schaffen täglich positive Erlebnisse – mit Service, der nicht nur funktioniert, sondern begeistert. Als erste Anlaufstelle für Kund innen, Kolleg innen und Partner bist du im Service die Visitenkarte unseres Unternehmens. Wir glauben daran, dass echter Service mehr ist als Abläufe und Prozesse: Es geht um Menschen, um Aufmerksamkeit und um das gute Gefühl, bestens betreut zu sein. Deine Mission bei uns: Du bist Organisationstalent, Möglichmacher in und Stimmungsträger in in einem. Du denkst mit, handelst proaktiv und behältst auch in stressigen Momenten den Überblick. Für dich bedeutet guter Service nicht nur „reagieren“, sondern aktiv gestalten – mit einem Lächeln, klarer Kommunikation und einem sicheren Gespür für das, was wirklich gebraucht wird. Unternehmen: Die Unternehmensgruppe DINNEBIER gehört zu den größten Autohandelsgruppen Deutschlands und ist seit über 30 Jahren erfolgreich am Automobilmarkt präsent. An insgesamt 25 Standorten sind wir mit den Marken Opel, Ford, Kia, Suzuki sowie den Premium Marken Land Rover und Jaguar in mehreren Bundesländern vertreten. Als modernes, zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen setzen wir auf engagierte Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen. Deine Aufgaben: Erster Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) für Kund*innen – persönlich, telefonisch und digital. Freundlicher Empfang und Betreuung unserer Kund*innen im Servicebereich. Terminvergabe und -koordination für Werkstatt- und Servicetermine. Anlage und Pflege von Kunden- und Fahrzeugdaten im System. Unterstützung des Service-Teams bei der täglichen Organisation und Kommunikation. Erstellung von Werkstattaufträgen und Rechnungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceberater. Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen , inkl. Unterlagen, Fahrzeugschlüssel, Leihwagen etc. Koordination und Verwaltung von Mietfahrzeugen am Standort. Kassenführung und Abrechnung. Bearbeitung des Post- und E-Mail-Verkehrs im Servicebereich. Mitwirkung bei Aktionen und Kampagnen , z. B. saisonale Serviceangebote. Sicherstellung eines professionellen und aufgeräumten Empfangsbereichs . Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Empfangs-, Service- oder Kundenbereich. Vorkenntnisse in der Automobilbranche sind von Vorteil. Du besitzt ein freundliches, professionelles Auftreten sowie eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung. Du bist ein Organisationstalent und besitzt ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen. jobs.title: Account Manager - Existing Customers (all genders)
jobs.description: Description In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren. Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt. Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort. Über die Rolle Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten. Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts. Das erwartet dich Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte. Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss. Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen. Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern. Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline. Was du mitbringst B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive. Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich. Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst. Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln. Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren. Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Warum uns? Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener. Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum. Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit. Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben. Benefits 30 Urlaubstage Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶 Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕 We mean it! Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser. Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen. Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team The Data Engineering team sits within the Central Data function, reporting to the Head of Data. We own the full data value chain: ingestion from source systems (billing, CRM, network, product, support, compliance), the data lake and warehouse layers, data quality and freshness. We don't own what the numbers mean — that's the business's call — but we own making sure the numbers are correct, timely, and traceable back to source. You'll join Data Engineering as a hands-on engineer working on our core lake platform — ingesting high-volume network and customer data, modeling it into clean, reliable datasets, and making it available for reporting and self-service analytics across the business. About the Role Develop and implement data models, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across raw and curated layers Create and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from source systems (billing, CRM, network, product, support) into our S3-based data lake Consume from and build reliable logic around Kafka topics, handling late, duplicate, or out-of-order events as they arrive Own data transformations in dbt, with tests and documentation so trust in the numbers is built in, not bolted on Orchestrate and monitor pipelines in Airflow, including retries, alerting, backfills, and SLAs Write efficient, well-structured SQL for transformation logic and ad-hoc investigation Contribute to data quality checks — completeness, freshness, reconciliation against source — and flag anomalies before they reach reporting Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth development processes and shared understanding. Take ownership of the quality and outcomes of your work, ensuring fully functional end-to-end flows. Create and maintain accurate, up-to-date technical documentation. Actively contribute to team discussions, with a mindset for continuous improvement and openness to new ideas or technologies. Requirements About You Must Have 3-5 years of hands-on data engineering experience Strong SQL — comfortable with window functions, CTEs, query optimization Solid experience building and maintaining data pipelines on AWS S3, Glue, and Athena (or a closely comparable lake/warehouse stack — e.g. Spark + Hive/EMR, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, Exasol — if you know the S3/Glue/Athena equivalents well) Practical understanding of data modelling: raw → conformed layers, dimensional modelling basics, thinking about how a table will actually be queried Experience consuming from Kafka (or another streaming/message system) as a data source Advanced proficiency in Python for ETL development, data manipulation and system automation Strong communication skills Nice to Have Airflow — DAG design, retries, backfills dbt — modelling, testing, documentation Exposure to Apache Iceberg or other open table formats Experience in telecom or another high-volume, regulated data environment (finance, healthcare) Benefits What We Offer? CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave. Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

About the Role The Deputy CISO runs 1GLOBAL's security function. This is an operational leadership role: you are the day-to-day head of security, reporting directly to the CISO with a dotted line to the CIO. You will lead the Cyber Defense organisation (SOC, Threat Detection and Response, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering). You will command incidents, own compliance execution across a multi-jurisdictional regulatory environment, and hold the Engineering-Security relationship together. The CISO owns governance and board accountability. You own delivery. About the Responsibilities Lead the Cyber Defense team. Own daily operational security performance across a distributed, high-availability telecoms environment. Serve as Incident Commander for significant security incidents. Maintain and continuously improve global incident response playbooks and readiness programmes. Oversee the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of critical security technologies: SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, IAM/PAM, network security, and cloud security platforms. Maintain technical standards, reference architectures, and hardening guidelines globally. Own telco-specific security domains: network core protection, signalling security (SS7/Diameter), mobile network security (4G/5G), OSS/BSS security, and cloud-native telecom environments. Own the security risk register day-to-day. Lead technical risk identification, quantification, and mitigation. Oversee penetration tests and red-team exercises; ensure findings are remediated promptly. Oversee Security Engineering: architecture review process, SDLC security, GSMA SGP compliance in product delivery. Ensure security is embedded in designs across Network Engineering, Cloud, IT, and Product. Approve operational security platform changes. Represent Security in the Engineering change process. Requirements About You 10+ years in cybersecurity; 5+ years in operational leadership (SecOps, Cyber Defense, Security Architecture). Proven incident commander in a production environment, ideally in global telecoms or other distributed, high-availability infrastructure. Deep familiarity with telco-specific security: network core protection, SS7/Diameter signalling, 4G/5G mobile network security, OSS/BSS, and cloud-native telecom environments. Strong background implementing and managing enterprise security platforms at scale: SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, IAM/PAM. Direct operational experience with at least two of: GSMA SAS-SM, NIS2, GDPR, MiFID II, DORA. Audit evidence, notifications, certification cycles. Experience leading hybrid internal/MSSP SOC models including MDR partner relationships. Familiarity with Zero Trust, Secure-by-Design, and automation-centric security approaches. GSMA standards familiarity (SGP.22, SGP.32, FS.18) is a strong advantage. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or GCIH are a plus. Builds trust with Engineering. Represents Security credibly at board and regulator level without the CISO in the room. Calm under pressure. Delivers bad news early. Benefits Why 1GLOBAL?
